name: ds-tg-bot
description: Discord + Telegram community bot with activity tracking, rules engine, disputes and monthly awards

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dsbot/db && npm run build -w @dsbot/shared && npm run build -w @dsbot/discord-bot && npm run build -w @dsbot/telegram-bot && npm run build -w @dsbot/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @dsbot/discord-bot && npm run lint -w @dsbot/telegram-bot && npm run lint -w @dsbot/web
